overall: The AG found the Committee violated the OML by failing to accurately record the April 5 roll call vote on responding to complaints; the minutes showed ten yes votes but only eight were cast. Ordered minutes revised and certified, plus future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the minutes of the April 5 meeting were inaccurate, specifically the recorded roll call vote on responding to two Open Meeting Law complaints.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to accurately record the roll call vote in the minutes of its April 5 meeting

remedy: Revise the minutes of the April 5 meeting to accurately reflect the roll call vote and certify to the AG's office within thirty days that this was done.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
